_about: One entry per sprite in ghdathegabbalion/Aster/sprites/. Each is regenerated img2img off its current file so pose, composition and setting survive while the design moves to canon. 'scene' is appended after characters/aster-prompt.txt. 'fix' names drift seen in the current file, so the checker knows what to look at first. Tune 'denoise' here, not in regen.py.

chibi._about: Desktop-pet cutouts. Rendered on a flat mint background so cutout.ps1 can key it out — mint is far from cream fur, lavender and ink-violet, so the flood fill stops cleanly at her edge. The source cutout is composited onto that mint inside the graph, because a transparent PNG fed straight to img2img comes out on black.
chibi.background: (plain flat mint green background:1.3), simple background, no scenery
chibi.prefix: chibi, super deformed, big head, stubby limbs, full body, lavender cable-knit sweater, white knitted scarf

frames._about: Multi-frame pet animations, from ghdathegabbalion/Aster docs/pet-frames.md (the source of truth for names, counts and timing — keep in step). Each frame is img2img off idle_cut.png at high denoise so the pose can change while scale, baseline and palette stay put. All frames of one clip share a seed, which keeps them looking like one sequence. Tail: the pet runtime strips each frame's painted tail and animates one shared tail, so every pose keeps the tail low to her right, in the idle position.
frames.suffix: tail curling low to the right behind her as in idle, same scale and baseline as idle
